versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Shopify Draggable skill.

- Provides drag-and-drop interactions with @shopify/draggable (v1.2.1)
- Supports Draggable (basic drag), Sortable (reordering), Droppable (drop zones), and Swappable (element swap) modules
- Describes plugin and sensor options for advanced behaviors such as mirror, snapping, collision detection, scroll, and accessibility
- Details configuration options, event APIs, and usage examples for sortable lists, grid swapping, and drop zones
- Includes guidance for plugin use, events, CSS customization, and extending with sensors
